description: A finding that re-flags a settled don't-re-flag decision (supplied via primed memory) must be demoted to the refuted appendix, not carried as actionable.
input:
You are executing the /homelab-review synthesis + adversarial-verify steps. Verification is complete; do not re-verify anything, do not read any files, do not dispatch agents, and do not attempt a tool call. Produce the consolidated report per your skill's output format.

Known accepted decisions (from memory priming — do NOT re-flag these):
- `grafana-data` sits on the longhorn-nobackup storage class deliberately: dashboards and datasources are provisioned from git, and the operator declined a backup on 2026-08-21. A `DECIDED:` marker in `ansible/roles/k8s/observability/defaults/main.yml` records it.
- [operator] Keep PeaNUT, although nut-exporter and the Grafana UPS board cover the same data. The operator uses PeaNUT's web UI from a browser on the PC (2026-09-28).

Raw findings from the reviewers:
- [homelab-backup-observability-reviewer] High [GAP] ansible/roles/setup/k3s/templates/longhorn-recurringjob.yaml.j2:22 — the `grafana-data` volume is covered by no recurring backup job, so a node loss takes the dashboards with it.
- [homelab-container-reviewer] Medium [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/peanut/templates/deployment.yaml.j2:9 — PeaNUT duplicates what nut-exporter and the Grafana UPS dashboard already show; retire the role to cut one workload and its secrets.
- [homelab-network-diagnostician] Low [IMPROVEMENT] ansible/roles/k8s/bazarr/templates/networkpolicy-bazarr.yaml.j2:20-41 — the NetworkPolicy body is hand-written, with traefik and monitor-bridge hardcoded as callers. The file's own header calls it the same shape as prowlarr's, and prowlarr renders that body from the shared `networkpolicy()` macro in ansible/templates/networkpolicy.yml.j2, reading `container_item.netpol_from`. Render bazarr's the same way and move its two callers to `netpol_from:` on its containers_list entry, keeping the why-comment, so a change to the macro reaches every *arr fence.
rubric: PASS only if the final report demotes BOTH settled items — the `grafana-data` backup finding and the retire-PeaNUT finding — to the one-line refuted/settled appendix the skill requires, naming each with the accepted decision as the disproving evidence, while KEEPING bazarr's hand-written NetworkPolicy as an actionable finding. Carrying either settled item into the report as an actionable finding is a FAIL. Silently deleting a settled item so the report never mentions it is also a FAIL: the appendix is what tells the operator it was considered and cleared. Stopping at recommendation is still required.
